title: Boxology: the isobar-thickness box count as an exact advection integral, and its rendering (code, data and results)
description:
The renderer, trajectory operator, verification harness, figure script and GFS archive reader behind the preprint Boxology: the isobar-thickness box count as an exact advection integral, and its rendering (E. J. Lane, 2026), together with the per-run results and the Krovanh track file needed to reproduce every figure and number in it.

The code is GPL-3.0-or-later; the manuscript and figures under paper/ are CC BY 4.0.
